name: gebco-2025
title: GEBCO_2025 Grid -- global 15 arc-second bathymetry and topography (GEBCO / Seabed 2030)
description: Global terrain model for ocean and land at 15 arc-second resolution, in metres, on a 43200 x 86400 pixel-centre-registered geographic grid (3,732,480,000 cells, WGS 84). The GEBCO_2025 release, published July 2025 by the GEBCO Compilation Group through The Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project. Held as the eight 90 x 90 degree quadrant GeoTIFFs upstream distributes, for each of the three products GEBCO ships: `gebco_2025` (land and ice-surface elevation), `gebco_2025_sub_ice_topo` (under-ice topography for Greenland and Antarctica) and `gebco_2025_TID` (Type Identifier -- the provenance code of every cell, e.g. multibeam, single beam, satellite-gravity-predicted, interpolated).

ethos:coverage_note:
Holds the GeoTIFF form of all three GEBCO_2025 products -- ice-surface elevation, sub-ice topography/bathymetry, and the Type Identifier grid -- each as the eight 90 x 90 degree quadrant tiles upstream distributes, 24 tiles in all, plus GEBCO's grid documentation and terms of use. That is the complete global coverage of the release at its native 15 arc-second resolution.
THIS MIRROR IS A SUBSET OF THE CEDA ARCHIVE -- 26 files here against 114 upstream, established 2026-09-18 by enumerating the archive directly. Not held: the netCDF form of all three products (~17.4 GiB, and the form most tools prefer -- GEBCO_2025.nc alone is 7,466,018,396 bytes), the Esri ASCII raster form, the .zip bundles that repackage the same tiles, and the .prj/.xml sidecars, 00readme.txt, the catalogue-and-licence README, and the .csv/.xlsx documentation the archive also carries. 
Also not held: the polar-stereographic companions. GEBCO's documentation has a section "Data in polar projection co-ordinates" stating that data sets accompany the GEBCO_2025 release for the polar regions -- IBCAO v5.1 in EPSG:3996 north of about 64 N, and IBCSO on a 500 m grid in EPSG:9354 south of 50 S.
The global single-file mosaics built from these tiles are catalogued as gebco-2025-combined.
